Lead requirements discovery and analysis for large or complex mobile initiatives, from problem framing through to post-release measurement Translate business objectives into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and journey maps that guide mobile design, development and testing Define mobile requirements in partnership with security, identity, solution architecture and engineering teams. Shape and review API integration requirements between mobile apps and back-end services, ensuring contracts align with business and user needs.
